rows.mechanism: Leveraged retail net margin buying over the last 20 sessions, scaled by float market cap, predicts lower forward returns (crowded, forced-deleveraging risk). Long the quintile with the LOWEST inflow. score = -sum(RZJME,20)/SZ.
rows.reopen: New contract only. Do not retune.

rows.mechanism: Margin balance as a fraction of float market cap = leverage overhang. Long the quintile with the LOWEST ratio. score = -RZYE/SZ.
rows.reopen: New contract only. Do not retune.

rows.mechanism: Names whose margin balance fell most over 60 sessions have already shed leveraged holders. Long the quintile with the LARGEST 60-session balance decline. score = -(RZYE_t / RZYE_{t-60} - 1).
rows.reopen: New contract only. Do not retune.
